title: CheckRepoVisibleToGithub
description: setup-project: check that the bot can see a repository. A POST /graphql whose JSON body is this, exactly as sent: the operation text byte for byte, plus its variables (values are never written into the operation text). The token goes in the Authorization header with Accept: application/vnd.github+json and X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28.

owner.description: The repository owner, from the repository URL.

name.description: The repository name, from the repository URL.
